The word कुमार 'a boy' is compounded with co-ordinate words श्रमण 'an ascetic' etc. and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।

Terms: समास-तत्-पुरुष

The affix णिनि comes after the verb हन् 'to kill' when the word in composition with it is कुमार 'a child' or शीर्ष 'head'.

Terms: णिनि

The affix ड्मतुप्‌ comes after the words 1. कुमुद 2. नड and 3. वेतस in the above four senses and the final of these words is elided before this affix.

Terms: ड्मतुप्‌

The affix टच् comes optionally after the word ब्रह्मण preceded by the words 1. कु and 2. महत् in a तत्-पुरुष समास ।

Terms: टच्

The words कुम्भपदी etc. have been formed by the similar elision of the अ of पाद।

Terms:

In a कर्मधारय समास the first member consisting of the word कुमार preserves it original accent.

Terms: कर्मधारय समास

The last syllable of the first member get the acute accent (उदात्त) when the word कुमारी follows, the compound denoting age.

Terms: समास end acute-1st-term

In a compound, the second member of which contains a guttural, there is ण in the room of न , that follows anything which standing in the prior member is qualified to cause the change, provided the न be at the end of a प्रातिपदिक , or be the augment नुम् , or occur in a विभक्ति।

Terms: सन्धि-हल्-आगमन-विभक्ति
